polityNote: Mali (Sudanese Republic within the Mali Federation from 1960-06-20, Republic of Mali from 1960-09-22) to 2019. Atoms: geoBoundaries MLI ADM2 2017 (DNCT/OCHA, CC BY 4.0) — the 49 cercles of 1992-2016 plus the District of Bamako. Rewritten (2026-10-06) from the earlier ne-admin1 dossier so that Ménaka (one cercle) and the 1960-77 regions can be drawn with one atom set over the whole scope. The national outline is the 2017 one: the Kayes treaty with Mauritania (1963-02-16) and the ICJ Agacher judgment (1986-12-22) are polity-level outline changes, not handled here. ① check (2026-10-06): union areas on 2000-01-01 against the areas Statoids publishes (uml.html, source: Statesman's Yearbook) — Kayes 123,023/119,743 km² (1.03), Koulikoro 90,871/95,848 (0.95; fr.wikipedia gives 90,120 → 1.01), District 247/252 (0.98), Sikasso 72,005/70,280 (1.02), Ségou 62,227/64,821 (0.96), Mopti 79,509/79,017 (1.01), Tombouctou 500,719/496,611 (1.01), Gao 179,212/170,572 (1.05), Kidal 150,588/151,430 (0.99); country 1,258,400/1,248,574 (1.01).
